content.title: Following up after a quotation or visit — Car Sales Executive (B1)

context.setting: A telephone follow-up after Aditi's showroom visit. She received a quotation for her chosen version and agreed to a follow-up call. Her purchase decision remains open.
context.learnerRole: Car Sales Executive following up respectfully on an earlier enquiry.
context.objective: Refer to the earlier quotation, check whether the customer can talk, invite questions and agree the next contact without pressure.
constraints: Do not assume the customer has decided to buy.
Do not invent prices, stock availability, delivery dates, finance terms or approvals.
Respect the customer's stated contact preference; give no financial or regulatory advice.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hello, Aditi. I'm following up on the quotation after your showroom visit. Is now a good time?

turns.speaker: Aditi
turns.text: I have a few minutes, but I haven't decided yet.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Have you had a chance to look at the quotation for your chosen version?

turns.speaker: Aditi
turns.text: Yes. I still have a question about the optional additions.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Which part would you like us to clarify before you consider the quotation further?

turns.speaker: Aditi
turns.text: I'd like to know which additions are included. Please reply by email.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I'll check that question. When would you prefer us to follow up again?

turns.speaker: Aditi
turns.text: Please wait until I've read the email. I'll contact you if I need anything else.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Understood. I'll send the clarification after checking it and leave the next contact to you.

keyExpressions.text: I'm following up on the quotation after your showroom visit.
Have you had a chance to look at the quotation for your chosen version?
keyExpressions.note: Invite a response without assuming a decision.

keyExpressions.text: When would you prefer us to follow up again?
keyExpressions.note: Let the customer state a contact preference.

vocabulary.definition: Contacting someone again about an earlier matter.
vocabulary.example: I'm following up on the quotation.

vocabulary.definition: A visit to see and discuss vehicles at a dealership.
vocabulary.example: I'm calling after your showroom visit.

vocabulary.definition: An explanation that makes something clearer.
vocabulary.example: I'll email the clarification after checking it.

vocabulary.definition: A choice about whether or what to buy.
vocabulary.example: Your purchase decision is still open.

vocabulary.definition: How or when someone wants to be contacted.
To think about an option before deciding.
vocabulary.example: Take time to consider the quotation.
I'm following up on your vehicle enquiry.

notes: A question about the quotation is not acceptance of it.
In the model, the next purchase-related contact is left to the customer after the requested clarification email.

items.q: You are calling after an agreed showroom follow-up.
options: I'm following up on your quotation. Is now a good time?
You haven't bought the car yet. Why not?

answers: I'm following up on your quotation. Is now a good time?

items.q: Rewrite: 'Since you've chosen to buy, I'll arrange the next step.' The customer has not decided.

answers: Have you had a chance to consider the quotation?

items.q: The customer asks for one clarification email and says they will contact you afterwards. What will you do?

answers: Send the checked clarification by email and leave the next contact to the customer.

rolePractice.instructions: Work in pairs. Refer to the earlier showroom visit, check whether the customer can talk, and ask about the quotation. Listen to the contact preference and close accordingly. Change roles.

cards.goal: Find out what the customer needs after the visit.
cards.info: The quotation concerns the chosen version. You cannot assume a purchase decision or answer an unverified inclusion question. Agree the next contact respectfully.

cards.goal: Get clarification without committing to buy.
cards.info: You can talk briefly. Ask about optional additions. Request an email, then explain that you will contact the dealership if you need anything else.

performanceTask.prompt: Write a short follow-up message after a showroom visit. The customer has a quotation but has not decided. Refer to that quotation, invite questions, and ask how they would prefer to continue. Do not add a deadline, offer or availability claim.
successCriteria: Identify the earlier visit or quotation.
Invite a response without assuming a purchase.
Ask about the customer's preferred next contact.
Use courteous B1 English without pressure or unsupported claims.

selfCheck: Did I refer to the earlier enquiry?
Did I invite the customer's questions?
Did I respect the contact preference?
Did I avoid pressure or assumptions?

reviewRetrieval.prompt: Later, without looking, open a follow-up linked to a quotation.
reviewRetrieval.answer: I'm following up on the quotation after your showroom visit.

reviewRetrieval.prompt: The customer wants to make the next contact. Give an appropriate closing.
reviewRetrieval.answer: Understood. I'll leave the next contact to you.
